common.disclaimer: Student proof of concept – synthetic data – not an OCBC product
common.readAloudUnavailable: Read aloud isn't available on this device.
common.newPayeeA11y: New payee – you have never paid them before
common.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
common.offlineTitle: We can't reach SafeBank right now
common.offlineBody: Please check your internet connection, then try again.

help.title: Get help
help.body: Not sure about a call, message or payment? Stop and check with us first.
help.helplineDesc: Free, 24 hours. Run by the National Crime Prevention Council.

login.title: Sign in to SafeBank
login.required: Please enter your username and password.

home.verifyCallDesc: Someone says they're from SafeBank? Check here.
home.offlineDraft: Not sent – saved on this phone while SafeBank was unreachable

pay.title: Pay someone
pay.choosePayee: Who do you want to pay?
pay.newPayeeHint: You've never paid this person before.
pay.errChoosePayee: Please choose who you want to pay.
pay.errAmountPositive: The amount must be more than S$0.
pay.errAmountDecimals: Please use at most 2 decimal places, for example 120.50.
pay.errAmountBalance: This is more than your balance of {{balance}}. Please enter a smaller amount.
pay.failTitle: We can't check this payment right now
pay.failBody: So we have NOT sent it. Your money is safe. You can try again, save it on this phone for later, or cancel.
pay.failSaved: Saved on this phone. Nothing was sent.

reasons.title: Why we're checking
reasons.new_payee: You have never paid this person or account before.
reasons.on_call: You are on a phone call right now.
reasons.recent_call: You finished a phone call less than 10 minutes ago.
reasons.chatting: Someone is messaging you about this payment.
reasons.amount_medium: This is a large payment (S$1,000 or more).
reasons.amount_high: This is a very large payment (S$10,000 or more).
reasons.unusual_amount: This is much larger than your usual payments.
reasons.q_phone: You said someone on the phone is telling you to pay.
reasons.q_secret: You were told to keep this secret or move money to a 'safe' account.
reasons.q_online: You have only met this person online or by phone.
reasons.q_chat: You said someone is messaging you, telling you to pay.
reasons.override_new_payee_live: A new payee while you are on a call or chat is a common scam pattern.
reasons.signals_unavailable: We could not check your phone for calls, so we're asking a few questions.

questions.title: A few quick safety questions
questions.hint: There is no wrong answer. Your answers help us protect you.
questions.q_phone: Is someone on the phone telling you to make this payment?
questions.q_secret: Were you told to keep this secret, or to move money to a 'safe' or 'safety' account?
questions.q_online: Have you only met or spoken to this person online or by phone?
questions.q_chat: Is someone messaging you on WhatsApp, Telegram or social media telling you to pay?

review.title: Check and send
review.askNote: We noticed something worth a second look. If you're sure, you can send it.

pause.title: Let's pause this payment
pause.subtitle: Nothing has been sent. Your money is still safe.
pause.whatNext: What would you like to do?
pause.trustedNone: Add a trusted contact in Settings first
pause.sheetTitle: Scammers often tell you to ignore warnings. Are you sure?
pause.sheetBody: If anyone is telling you what to do right now, stop. A real bank, MAS or police officer will never rush you.

save.title: Save for later
save.choose: When would you like to be able to send it?
save.why: Waiting gives you time to check with someone you trust. Scammers don't like waiting.
save.ready: The waiting time is over. If you're still sure, you can send it now.

trusted.waitingBody: We've asked {{name}} to look at this payment. Please call them now and talk it through.
trusted.timeoutBody: You can still save this payment for later or call SafeBank.
trusted.okBody: They've talked to you about this payment. You can send it now.
trusted.stopBody: SafeBank will review it with you. Nothing has been sent and your money is safe.

result.approvedBody: {{amount}} sent to {{payee}} after a SafeBank check.
result.cancelledBody: Nothing was sent. Your money is safe.
result.reviewBody: Nothing has been sent. A SafeBank officer will contact you in the app. You can also call us now.
result.escalatedBody: SafeBank has held this payment and reported it to the Anti-Scam Centre. Nothing was sent. We will contact you in the app.

banners.call: You're on a call. Scammers often stay on the line while you pay. Hang up first, then check.
banners.chat: Someone is messaging you about this payment. Scammers pretend to be officials, employers, sellers or friends. Stop and check first.
banners.screen: Your screen is being shared. Stop sharing before you pay.
banners.unavailable: We can't check for calls on this phone, so we'll ask you a few questions.

signals.permissionTitle: Let SafeBank check if you're on a call?
signals.permissionBody: We only check whether you're on a call, never who you're talking to or what is said. This helps us warn you if a scammer is on the line.

call.title: Call SafeBank
call.waitingStaff: Calling SafeBank… an officer will answer shortly.
call.incomingBody: This is a genuine call from the SafeBank Fraud Team inside the app.
call.fallback: We switched to text chat because the voice call couldn't connect.
call.endedBody: Thank you. Your payment stays paused until you or SafeBank decide.
call.noMessages: Messages you send here go only to the SafeBank officer.

verify.title: Verify a call
verify.intro: Someone on the phone says they're from SafeBank? Check here.
verify.genuine: This is a genuine SafeBank call
verify.genuineBody: {{name}} from the SafeBank Fraud Team is calling you in this app.
verify.notCalling: SafeBank is NOT calling you right now.
verify.notCallingBody: If someone says they're from SafeBank, MAS or the Police, hang up and call us in-app.

check.title: Is this real?
check.subtitle: Paste a message you received. We'll look for warning signs.
check.label: Message to check
check.placeholder: Paste or type the message here
check.errEmpty: Please paste a message to check.
check.likely_scamBody: This message has strong signs of a scam. Do not reply, click links or send money.
check.be_carefulBody: Some things in this message are often used by scammers. Check before you act.
check.no_signsBody: We didn't find common scam signs. Still, never share your OTP or move money because of a message.
check.not_sure: Not sure – check through an official channel
check.not_sureBody: We can't tell if this is real. Contact the company using a number from their official website or app, not from this message.
check.tapExplain: Underlined words are warning signs. Tap one to see why.
check.confidence: Our checker thinks there's a {{p}}% chance this is a scam.
check.reported: Reported. Thank you – SafeBank staff will look at it.
check.privacy: We only keep a copy with phone numbers hidden and links shortened.

flags.install_app: Asks you to install an app
flags.family_new_number: Family member with a new number

explain.urgency: Scammers rush you so you don't have time to think or check.
explain.safe_account: No real bank, MAS or police officer will ever ask you to move money to a 'safe account'.
explain.authority: Scammers pretend to be from MAS, the police or the courts to scare you.
explain.secrecy: Being told to keep a payment secret is a big warning sign.
explain.link: Links in messages can lead to fake websites that steal your details.
explain.install_app: Installing an app from a link can let scammers control your phone.
explain.credentials: Never share your OTP, PIN or password. SafeBank will never ask for them.
explain.gift_crypto_gold: Requests for gift cards, crypto or gold, or 'guaranteed' profits, are common scams.
explain.upfront_fee: Real jobs and prizes never ask you to pay a fee first.
explain.earn_per_day: Offers to 'earn $X per day' for easy tasks are almost always scams.
explain.move_chat: Scammers move you to Telegram or WhatsApp where they are harder to trace.
explain.paynow_first: 'Pay first, no meetup' is how most online shopping and ticket scams work.
explain.family_new_number: A 'family member' with a new number asking for money: call their old number first.

settings.title: Settings
settings.easyModeDesc: Bigger text and buttons, one thing per screen.
settings.readAloudDesc: Shows a Read aloud button on warnings, questions and results.
settings.trustedHelper: Someone we can ask before a risky payment goes out. A student can choose a parent; a senior can choose an adult child.
settings.noContact: You don't have a trusted contact yet.
settings.delayNotice: Changes take effect after {{time}}. This stops a scammer who has your phone from quickly changing your trusted contact.
settings.callDetectionDesc: On the Android app, SafeBank can check if you're on a phone call when you pay. We never read who you're talking to, the number, or what is said. A web browser can't see calls, so for new payees we simply ask you.

callStatus.browser: Web browser – we ask you instead

settings.replayGuide: Show the 'How you're protected' guide again

guide.label: How you're protected
guide.c1Body: If a payment looks like a scam, we stop it for a moment so you can check. You're always in control.
guide.c2Title: We'll never ask you to move money to a 'safe account'
guide.c2Body: Not SafeBank, not MAS, not the Police. Anyone who asks is a scammer.
guide.c3Body: Someone says they're from SafeBank? Tap 'Verify a call' on Home to see if it's really us.

contact.title: Requests from family
contact.intro: When someone you look after makes a risky payment, it shows up here.
contact.callFirst: Please call them before you decide.
contact.stopNote: This doesn't block them forever. SafeBank staff will review it with them.

session.title: Are you still there?
session.body: For your safety, you'll be signed out in {{s}} seconds.

live.title: Before you pay
live.question: Are you on a phone call or chatting with someone about this payment right now?
live.why: Scammers often stay on the phone or keep messaging while you pay. Your answer helps us protect you. We never listen to calls or read your chats.

addPayee.title: Add a new payee
addPayee.intro: Add someone you want to pay. New payees are checked more carefully the first time.
addPayee.name: Payee name
addPayee.refHelper: 6 to 20 letters or digits. Spaces and dashes are fine.
addPayee.errName: Please enter the payee's name (at least 2 letters).
addPayee.errRef: Please enter an account number of 6 to 20 letters or digits.
addPayee.newNote: This payee will show as NEW until your first payment to them goes through.
